title: Egyptian conquest of Ottoman Syria
notes: Ibrahim Pasha's army entered Palestine in late October 1831 and besieged Acre from November; the Convention of Kutahya (May 1833) left Syria, Palestine and Adana to Egypt.

title: Egyptian conquest of the Sudan
notes: Ismail Pasha's expedition left in October 1820; Dongola submitted by November 1820, Sennar fell in June 1821, Kordofan after the battle of Bara in August 1821.

title: Bolivian intervention in Peru
notes: Santa Cruz entered Peru in June 1835; the Confederation was proclaimed on 28 October 1836. Computed, never emitted: vanilla sets Bolivia to 50.

title: Russo-Persian War
notes: Persia attacked in July 1826; Russia added the territorial demands and took the Erivan and Nakhchivan khanates at Turkmenchay.

title: Russo-Turkish War
notes: Russia declared war in April 1828; Adrianople gave Russia the Danube delta. The protectorate over Moldavia and Wallachia is not a Vic3 subject transfer (they remain Ottoman subjects in 1836) and is not modelled.

title: First Anglo-Burmese War
notes: Fought by the East India Company (BIC); Yandabo ceded Arakan, Tenasserim and Burmese Assam.

title: Great-power backing of Greek independence
notes: Treaty of London (6 July 1827) to the London Protocol (3 February 1830); one liberate_country goal per backer.

title: French conquest of the Regency of Algiers
notes: Landing at Sidi Ferruch 14 June 1830; Algiers 5 July 1830, Oran 4 January 1831, Bone 27 March 1832. The Regency has no 1836 tag.

title: Great-power backing of Belgian independence
notes: London Protocol of 20 December 1830 recognised Belgian independence; the Netherlands accepted only in 1839, so the goal is pending on 1836-01-01.

title: Ten Days' Campaign
notes: Dutch attempt to retake Belgium, abandoned under French intervention.

title: Sikh annexation of Peshawar
notes: Hari Singh Nalwa took Peshawar from the Barakzai sardars; formal annexation 6 May 1834.

title: Dogra invasion of Ladakh
notes: Zorawar Singh's campaign (August 1834 to October 1835) under Ranjit Singh's vassal Gulab Singh; Ladakh is still independent in vanilla 1836, so the goal is pending.

title: Vietnamese takeover of Cambodia
notes: Siamese invasion repelled by April 1834; Minh Mang placed Cambodia under direct rule as Tay Thanh in late 1834. Cambodia is a Vietnamese vassal in vanilla 1836.

title: Siamese invasion of Cambodia
notes: Bodindecha's invasion failed; Siamese forces withdrew by April 1834.

title: Siamese destruction of Vientiane
notes: Anouvong's advance in January 1827; Vientiane taken in 1827 and razed in 1828; the kingdom was annexed.

title: Siamese invasion of Kedah
notes: The governor of Ligor invaded on 12 November 1821 and took Kedah fort on the 18th.

title: Haitian occupation of Santo Domingo
notes: Boyer's army entered Santo Domingo on 9 February 1822.

title: Barradas expedition
notes: Spanish landing at Tampico 27 July 1829; capitulation 11 September 1829.

title: Persian siege of Herat
notes: Abbas Mirza's campaign from summer 1833; the siege was lifted in November 1833 after his death with only nominal suzerainty acknowledged.

title: Merina conquests under Radama I
notes: East coast submitted in 1817; the west was reduced by 1824.
